scenes.text: Have you ever wondered how the Amazon rainforest stays so incredibly lush and green when its own soil is actually nutrient-poor?
The secret is mind-blowing, and it starts thousands of miles away in the Sahara Desert where powerful windstorms kick up millions of tons of dust.
This massive dust cloud travels across the entire Atlantic Ocean, carrying vital phosphorus that the Amazon desperately needs to survive but constantly loses to heavy rains.
Without this Saharan dust, the world's largest rainforest would starve, so drop a comment with your thoughts and hit follow for more nature secrets!
